title: Control Plane Composition Request Record
description: Immutable record of one approved composition (S2-1/S2-2). It wraps the EXACT Composition Request payload the Composer consumes and carries the provenance in the wrapper: the approved configuration digest, the effective approval record and the generator identity. The nested request holds no control-plane field — a provenance key inside it would be a second authority speaking in the Composer's own document. The record authorizes composition only; the produced Platform Manifest is a draft and the manifest lifecycle keeps its sole publication authority.

approval_ref.description: The approval record that had to be effective before this record could exist.

generator_version.description: Identity of the generator that produced the payload; participates in the record digest, so a behaviour change is visible.

request.description: The exact Composition Request payload (the Composer's own normative schema governs it). Control-plane provenance fields are forbidden here.
